hypothesis: Adding snapshot-, query-, filter-, and threshold-bound cursors to exact reviewed-change search will make every matching record reachable without mixing pages from different evidence views or expanding the companion's read-only authority.

motivation.measuredBaselineGap: searchChanges('ruflo', 20, {}, now, 1) reports 25 matches but returns 20 with no continuation cursor.
motivation.priorCondition: The 2026-09-19 report deferred search cursors until thresholded results exceeded one page; that condition is now met.
motivation.upstream: Dream Machine aa931caad5dd0108253645bba0ab1481ad7da0ee adds governed ruOS preflight and receipt validation. It is reviewed evidence, not code copied into this companion.

heldOut: a 20-record first page for full-overlap query ruflo exposes its snapshot, offset, total and an opaque continuation cursor
continuation returns the remaining records and concatenation equals an independently computed exact-match oracle without gaps or duplicates
small-page traversal terminates and visits every match exactly once
malformed, changed-snapshot, cross-query, cross-filter and cross-threshold cursor reuse fails closed
omitted pagination preserves deterministic one-page and no-match search behavior
the reviewed Dream Machine source and governed ruOS receipt/preflight records are revision-pinned and searchable without claiming live evaluation

acceptance.tests: all existing and new tests pass on Node 22 and 24
acceptance.schemas: both marketplace schemas, four skills, six MCP tools and three resources validate
acceptance.metaharness: metaharness@0.4.16 retains 6/6 hard constraints; score alone is not proof
acceptance.security: zero confirmed high or critical findings; scanner coverage and residual risk disclosed

performance.design: 15 alternating pairs; 10000 exact-search calls and 20 cold CLI starts per arm per pair; seed 1729
performance.searchP95: candidate no more than 20 percent and 0.05 ms above baseline median
performance.coldCliP95: candidate no more than 20 percent and 5 ms above baseline median
performance.rss: candidate no more than 5242880 bytes above baseline median

acceptance.package: dependency lock unchanged, package closure validates and compressed archive remains below 40000 bytes

ruos.selection: Existing dedicated evolution-candidate desktop; no retained activity was reported. The personal Mac and other shared desktops are excluded.
ruos.preflight: Run exactly one harmless true command and one real screenshot through authorized tools. Require status ok, numeric exitCode 0, completionVersion 1 and completionVerified true plus actual image bytes.
ruos.verifier: Trusted Dream Machine scripts/ruos-preflight.mjs at aa931caad5dd0108253645bba0ab1481ad7da0ee.
ruos.decision: Missing liveness, isolation, completion provenance or pixels is INCONCLUSIVE. Preflight never authorizes promotion.

memory.decision: Do not add RuVector, WASM or GNN complexity below the frozen record gate.

rollback: Revert the candidate commit; version 0.7.0 search behavior remains the parent.
